# <span id="aanchor303"></span> Logout/Login

Select **Logout/Login** from the Settings menu to log in and out of FLOWCAL. This also provides a convenient tool for administrators when switching between an admin-level user account and a normal user account.

This functionality is not available for FLOWCAL Instant Login users.

<div class="procedure">

To log in to or out of FLOWCAL:

- Press the **F10** button on the keyboard; or
- Go to **Settings** \> **Logout/Login**.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 273;height: 318;" />

</div>
